referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The initial page is a single viewport with a full-bleed, darkened clinical interior behind a centered logo mark, large two-line practice identity, one short care promise, one primary inquiry CTA, and a four-part navigation index. Selecting a destination opens one focused content panel above the blurred stage. The service panel is an editorial ruled list, approach uses three short steps, FAQs answer practical questions, and Contact carries the local-only sample form. Mobile keeps the stage centered, rearranges the four destinations into a 2 by 2 grid, and makes panels vertically scrollable. The photographs are original generated illustrations. This contract transfers geometry and interaction mechanics only, never the sample provider's identity, exact wording, colors, or image assets.

acceptanceChecks: At 1440 by 900, the full-bleed centered hero and primary CTA fit within one viewport.
The initial navigation exposes Services, Approach, FAQs, and Contact as four distinct working destinations.
Selecting a navigation destination shows exactly one readable overlay panel and Escape closes it.
At 390 by 844, the four-way nav becomes a two-column grid and the page has no horizontal overflow.
No original demo photo, remote font, fake business contact, or unsourced claim appears in the page.

review.notes: Verified desktop and mobile local full-page captures, modal navigation, imagery, and zero horizontal overflow. All photography is generated for this dossier; no original demo photography is included.
